cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Yes, Under My Physics
cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Absolutely, I'll help move your boxes downstairs. Help means saving effort; I'll call the lift. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's broken. Carry that box yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Certainly. Yourself means without involving you. I'll hire a mover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He'll carry them if you hold the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. Holding means preventing movement. I'll wedge the door open and supervise from this chair.

mechanism: A agrees to moving help and purchases or supplies alternatives while defining each demand so A remains a seated supervisor.
confusable: Unlike simply delegating or refusing, every yes is followed by a narrowed definition that preserves A preferred low-effort role.
comparison: Paid moving and a door wedge differ from reframed camera directions.
seedUse: D167-b lift, hired mover, door wedge and chair; S02-b takes cost and practical arrangements to keep B cooperating.
